source_behavior.summary: Execution Center exposes a connect-site action when the authoritative current-tenant site collection is empty.
source_behavior.success_semantics: the user is taken to the real tenant-scoped site connection workspace only after the current tenant is proven to own zero sites

laravel_adaptation.runtime_wiring: ExecutionConnectSiteControl is mounted only on the existing execution RouteElement

authorization.missing_permission: control remains hidden and the authoritative sites request is not issued
authorization.sites_read: real tenant-scoped API guarded by the existing authenticated tenant context

tenant_isolation.tenant_source: authoritative FrontendContext.tenant.slug and tenant-specific sites endpoint
tenant_isolation.same_tenant_sites_read: 200 for an authenticated member with required site-read permissions
tenant_isolation.foreign_tenant_sites_read: 404 for a user without membership in that tenant
tenant_isolation.idor_result: the control adds no caller-selected tenant or resource identifier and cross-tenant reads fail closed

runtime_semantics.idempotency: navigation and the backing read are read-only and safe to repeat

frontend: execution-connect-site-control.test.tsx proves authoritative empty-site gating, tenant-qualified destination, permission fail-closed behavior, malformed/read-error fail-closed behavior, existing-site suppression, and Arabic RTL copy

canonical_denominator.note: Counts are observations from the live generator before this focused closure is applied. The repository generator remains the sole authority for any resulting count change.

terminality.reason: The merged Laravel control is wired to the real Execution Center, derives its destination from authoritative tenant context, renders only after a real empty sites read, fails closed on missing permission or bad reads, and now has explicit server-side cross-tenant 404 acceptance evidence. Canonical status is still applied only by repository reconciliation tooling.
